result.title: When high water closes the sculpture garden, pick up an indoor route
result.description: Help visitors adjust their plans with the free printed route through the permanent indoor sculpture galleries. It starts at the front desk, follows step-free public corridors and ends at the café. Visitors should check the same-day garden notice before travelling.
result.audience: Museum visitors planning to see the sculpture garden
result.rationale: The indoor route gives those visitors a practical alternative during a high-water closure, while the same-day notice helps them plan their visit.
result.evidence: The visitor note describes the free front-desk route, its endpoints and step-free corridors. It asks visitors to check the same-day notice and describes the route as an alternative during a high-water closure.
